root.label: Intel uses High NA EUV technology for advanced chip manufacturing

events.label: Intel uses High NA EUV technology for advanced chip manufacturing

slots.name: Intel High NA EUV use status
slots.sentence: While Intel (INTC.O) is already using ASML's newest tools for its laptop chips, ASML said this week it plans to move up to a larger mask size that would let its newest tools make chips as large as today's biggest data center chips.
